name: oh-my-codex
description: Multi-agent orchestration layer for OpenAI Codex CLI

scripts.build:full: npm run build && npm run build:explore:release && npm run build:sparkshell && npm run build:api
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run verify:native-agents && npm run sync:plugin && npm run verify:plugin-bundle && npm run clean:native-package-assets
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='./dist/scripts/postinstall.js';if(fs.existsSync(p))import(p).then(m=>m.main?.()).catch(e=>console.warn('[omx] Postinstall skipped after a non-fatal error: '+(e?.message??e)))"
scripts.test:team:cross-rebase-smoke: npm run build && npm run test:team:cross-rebase-smoke:compiled
scripts.test:recent-bug-regressions: npm run build && npm run test:recent-bug-regressions:compiled
scripts.test:workflow-critical: npm run build && npm run test:workflow-critical:compiled
scripts.test:code-review: npm run build && npm run test:code-review:compiled
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run verify:native-agents && npm run verify:plugin-bundle && npm run test:node && node dist/scripts/generate-catalog-docs.js --check
scripts.coverage:team-critical: npm run build && npm run coverage:team-critical:compiled
scripts.coverage:team-critical:compiled: c8 --all --src dist/team --src dist/state --include 'dist/team/**/*.js' --include 'dist/state/**/*.js' --exclude '**/__tests__/**' --reporter=text-summary --reporter=lcov --reporter=json-summary --report-dir coverage/team --check-coverage --lines=78 --functions=90 --branches=70 --statements=78 node dist/scripts/run-test-files.js dist/team/__tests__ dist/state/__tests__
scripts.coverage:workflow-critical: npm run build && npm run coverage:workflow-critical:compiled
scripts.coverage:workflow-critical:compiled: c8 --all --src dist/code-review --src dist/hooks --src dist/scripts --src dist/mcp --src dist/pipeline --src dist/cli --src dist/state --include 'dist/code-review/**/*.js' --include 'dist/hooks/keyword-detector.js' --include 'dist/scripts/codex-native-hook.js' --include 'dist/scripts/check-coverage.js' --include 'dist/scripts/run-core-mutation.js' --include 'dist/scripts/run-compiled-ci.js' --include 'dist/scripts/run-release-gates.js' --include 'dist/scripts/run-test-files.js' --include --reporter=lcov --reporter=json-summary --reporter=json --report-dir coverage/workflow-critical node dist/scripts/run-test-files.js dist/code-review/__tests__ dist/hooks/__tests__/keyword-detector.test.js dist/scripts/__tests__/codex-native-hook.test.js dist/scripts/__tests__/check-coverage.test.js dist/scripts/__tests__/run-core-mutation.test.js dist/pipeline/__tests__/orchestrator.test.js dist/cli/__tests__/state-code-review.test.js dist/state/__tests__/code-review-overlay-failures.test.js scripts.coverage:ts:full:compiled: c8 --all --src dist --exclude '**/__tests__/**' --exclude 'dist/bin/**' --exclude 'dist/**/*.d.ts' --reporter=text-summary --reporter=lcov --reporter=json-summary --reporter=json --report-dir coverage/ts-full node dist/scripts/run-test-files.js dist

scripts.coverage:ts:full:checked:compiled: npm run coverage:ts:full:compiled && node dist/scripts/check-coverage.js --summary coverage/ts-full/coverage-summary.json --coverage coverage/ts-full/coverage-final.json --unreachable-exceptions coverage-unreachable-lines.json --critical-prefix src/code-review/verdict.ts --critical-prefix src/code-review/scope.ts --critical-prefix src/code-review/capabilities.ts --critical-prefix src/code-review/evidence.ts --critical-prefix src/code-review/coordinator.ts --critical-prefix src/hooks/keyword-detector.ts --critical-prefix src/scripts/codex-native-hook.ts --critical-prefix src/scripts/check-coverage.ts --critical-prefix src/scripts/run-core-mutation.ts --critical-prefix src/state/skill-active.ts --critical-prefix src/state/workflow-transition.ts --critical-prefix src/pipeline/review-verdict.ts --critical-prefix src/pipeline/stages/code-review.ts --require-merge-base

scripts.test:compat:node: npm run build && node dist/scripts/run-test-files.js dist/compat/__tests__
scripts.test:compat:node:cross-platform: npm run build && node dist/scripts/run-test-files.js dist/compat/__tests__
